title: Concept: Repository backed by a filesystem path
description: build.gradle declares a repository URL of the `file:` scheme, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a repository URL of the `file:` scheme.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through build.gradle (gradle).
risk: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a repository URL of the `file:` scheme.
